purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for the Ash-Below Compact's exposed copy-and-relief operation at Ninth Furnace.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for bakehouse routine, compact roster, separated records, registrar exposure, the one-token threshold, and four state-gated aftermath families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for establishing work, introducing the compact, the three-record closeup, preparation choice and fold, Nema's entrance, the exposed route strip, the passage token, the final threshold, and each ending family. The first horn and Nema's torn route strip receive distinct replay beats because each changes the room's power geometry.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt is a complete affirmative description of one frame for a general image model. Prompt assembly adds only visible named-character refs, the global style cue, and triggered state or branch modifiers. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: painterly high-fantasy storybook illustration with soot-dark geothermal masonry, ember-orange and oxidized-copper color, precise tactile work objects, expressive human posture, readable political staging, restrained magical ambiguity, cinematic interactive-fiction framing, unlettered surfaces.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble global_style_cue plus the selected base_image_prompt plus visual refs only for agents or groups listed in visible_characters, then append triggered state_image_modifiers and global_branch_image_modifiers. Use the embedded coordinate scene_set as geometry authority for every camera slot.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: All replay beats occupy one fixture-bounded bakehouse and its visible stair landing. The embedded measured coordinate map fixes walls, routes, occlusion, cameras, props, and staging slots for B-level replay continuity.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: A 3D blockout may improve production-quality repaint consistency, but the embedded coordinate layout is the current durable geometry authority and does not depend on generated concept art.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide interior of a compact high-fantasy geothermal bakehouse built from dark fitted stone. Six arched ovens glow along the north wall beneath copper heat pipes; a long waist-high scoring table runs east to west through the center; a washing trough at the northwest corner holds cold water and a skin of steam from nearby ovens; reed bread trays line the west wall; a slatted ironwood door on the east wall opens to a steep stone stair rising toward a furnace court; a lower south stair descends beside a burial-meal shelf. Ves, a sturdy adult tally keeper in a flour-gray apron, scores flat ration loaves at the central table while three bakers in rolled work wraps move loaves with long wooden peels. Ember light and pale shaft light reveal soot, flour, clay tally ties, and exact working routes.

three bakers moving between ovens, cooling rack, and reed trays

The visible cold-water trough is a consequence of the East Collar diversion; the ovens remain hot.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for characters visible in each frame.

characters.ves: Ves: sturdy human adult tally keeper, medium-brown skin, short black curls covered by a folded cream headcloth, square expressive face, soot-gray tunic with sleeves rolled to the elbow, flour-gray apron crossed at the back, dark work trousers, blunt bone scoring tool and clay tally ties at the belt, practical planted stance, hands usually flour-marked. This is individual appearance, not universal Jamnai physiology.
characters.enka: Enka: older human woman, broad body, deep-brown skin, gray hair shaved close at the temples and braided into one short knot, dark red work apron over layered charcoal clothing, ring of three large iron store keys worn visibly at the waist, heavy forearms dusted with flour, posture of domestic authority grounded near the relief trays.
characters.salen: Salen: lean human adult release-tradition carrier, light-brown skin, long ash-brown braid, narrow weathered face, patched gray knee-length carrier cloak over plain work clothes, soft leather boots, lidded reed burial basket and clay-knotted cords, quiet posture angled toward exits and handoff routes.
characters.taru: Taru: thick-set human man in middle age, warm brown skin, close-cropped dark hair streaked with gray, old pale burn scar across the right palm and two fingers, charcoal work wrap over a rust-colored under-tunic, small household copy case at the chest, body language divided between the oven's warmth and the controlled court door.
characters.melka: Melka: tall human woman in middle age, very dark skin, shaved scalp, long undyed linen coat with a pale ash sash, rigid palewood mortuary document case held in both hands, spare upright posture on the upper landing, face attentive and withholding judgment.
characters.nema: Nema: compact human woman in early middle age, ochre-brown skin, straight black hair bound into a low knot, sharp triangular face, soot-black branch wrap with narrow oxidized-copper edging, rigid bronze document case, black ink stylus tucked at the wrist, exact economical movements and a posture that uses the doorway as office furniture.

groups.bakehouse_workers_and_households: Ninth Furnace bakehouse workers and affected households: human adults of varied ages, builds, and skin tones in layered soot-gray, faded rust, cream, and dark red work wraps; bakers carry long wooden oven peels, reed trays, flour cloths, and clay household markers; household members carry cloth bags, lamp-oil cups, and small receipt tokens; practical work-worn posture and clear queue spacing.

review_notes: No images were generated. This visual plan and its BFL prompt batch are the complete visual deliverables for the fixture.

The embedded coordinate scene_set is the durable geometry authority for the fixture-bounded bakehouse, threshold, upper landing, and lower stair; generated images remain presentation output rather than spatial truth.
Prompts keep divine action visually ambiguous and stage only ordinary heat, records, horns, people, and court-weight effects visible from the bakehouse.
Character bodies and the measured bakehouse are local fixture elaborations, not universal Jamnai physiology or architecture.
